unavailable.reason: Individual retry attempts are not timestamped; only the final attempt count is stored. Shown instead: messages that needed a retry, by arrival time.
The time a worker STARTED processing is not stored (each claim overwrites it). Latency is therefore measured from intake to completion (end-to-end).
Messages rejected at intake (credentials, parsing, validation, facility mapping) are never stored; only temporary counters exist, reset whenever the service restarts.
Worker activity is recorded only inside the background service and is not stored, so it cannot be shown here (needs a stored heartbeat record, pending HF-39).
SOAP endpoint availability is not probed or recorded over time; only the configured switch state is known.
